message: A file that a developer tool runs on its own (an agent hook or helper, an environment override, an auto-approval, a task that runs on folder open, a dev container command, a shell-entry or git hook file, a git config that runs a program) was added or changed, or such a config cannot be read. Remove it, or ask a person to review it. A reviewed line may carry 'chock: allow <rule-id>' where the file has comments; a person adds it in their own commit. In the agent a waiver counts only for a line already committed in HEAD, so an agent asks the person rather than writing it.
